Whether you’re searching for your first home, a vacation cabin, or looking to make a move, I’m here to make the process as seamless and stress-free as possible.

draft.aboutParagraph: With deep roots in the Manistique Lakes area, my team and I offer friendly, knowledgeable service tailored to your needs. I’m proud that so many of my clients return or refer their friends—proof of the care we put into every transaction. ABOUT
The Right Realtor® Gets the Right Results
We strive to make the process of either buying or selling property as stress free as possible with our friendly and knowledgeable sales staff.
FROM THE SITE
Financing requirements.
Lenders typically look at your credit history, credit score, debt to income ratio, and how long you have had the same job to determine your eligibility for certain loan programs. The higher your credit score and the better your credit history, the more favorable the terms. But even if you have poor credit, it doesn’t mean that you won’t qualify for a home loan. There are several options available even with low down payment, down payment assistance programs, and grants.
